identity_check: Confirmed as Hundred (hundred.systems; http://hundred.systems and www.hundred.systems both 308-redirect to https://hundred.systems, which serves the site), maker of a benchtop station that images every incoming part in its shipping tray to find cosmetic defects under 100 µm at incoming quality control (IQC). The About page and Y Combinator's directory page (which links http://hundred.systems/) name the same three founders: Erica Diaz (CEO), Iris Liao (CTO) and Imani Gosserand (CPO). YC lists the company in its Fall 2026 batch, founded 2026, team size 3, location 'San Francisco' (no country shown; recorded as US); the company's own site gives no location or founding year (footer only '© 2026'). Not HundredX, Hundred5, hundred.co or consultancies called Hundred, and not the many '100'-branded companies: none of them is at the hundred.systems domain or sells incoming-part inspection. Category adjacent, layer quality_vision: Hundred sells camera-based incoming-part inspection (hardware station plus software, per-part photo record) to quality teams at IQC; it overlaps Utopian Autonomy's quality / process-stability and supplier-quality side only through inspection, with no plant-staff agents for procurement or maintenance; same call as Qualitas Technologies and Frinks AI (adjacent / quality_vision). Sector industrial_manufacturing classified from its own words: the homepage title reads 'AI visual inspection for contract manufacturers'.

company.name: Hundred
company.description: Early-stage San Francisco startup building a benchtop station that images whole trays of incoming parts to catch sub-100 µm cosmetic defects before assembly.

layer_detail: Tray-level visual inspection of incoming (and outgoing) parts at IQC / OQC: one-shot anomaly detection against a single golden sample, batch 'sibling consensus', and checks for known molding defects (flash, short shots); pass / fail grading to the customer's existing cosmetic spec with defect heat maps, quarantine flags and a per-part photo record for later failure analysis. Own inspection station plus software; positions itself against Keyence VS in-line cameras, Instrumental line stations and manual visual inspection.
product_summary: Benchtop inspection station for incoming quality checks: an operator calibrates it from one known-good sample, loads a full shipping tray, and the system flags cosmetic defects under 100 µm with heat maps, grades each part pass or fail against existing cosmetic specs, and keeps a photo record per part.
